page.layout: One page of running text in the main block with its lettered and cited lists. Printed line numbers (5 to 35) stand in the left margin beside the text. Running head "BIBLICUS." at top centre, page number 327 at top right. Signature "X 4" and catchword "a) Gen." at the foot.

main_text.p: a) Gen.17.v.7. Stabilio fœdus meum inter me & te, &c. §mefore tibiin Deum & femini tuo.
Exod.3.v.6.Ego sum Deus patris tui, Deus Abrahami, & Deus Isaaci, & Deus Iacobi. Confer Matth.22.v.32.
Esa.51.v.6. Salus mea in sæculum erit.
Matth.8.vers.[?]11. Dico vobis, Multi ab oriente & occidente ve-10nient, & discumbent cum Abrahamo, & Isaaco, & Iacobo, in re-gno cœlorum.
b) Actor.15.vers.11. Imò per gratiam Domini nostri Iesu Christi credimus nos seruatum iri: quemadmodum & illi, scilicet patres.
15c) Ioh.8.vers.56. Abraham gestiuit videre diem meum: & vidit, & gauisus est.
Hebr.11.v.4. Abel per fidem maioris pretij sacrificium obtulit Deo quàm Cain.
Et cap.13.vers.8. Iesus Christus heri & hodie idem est, & in 20sæcula.
3. Euangelium & fœdus gratiæ modo promulgationis & administrationis fuit diuersum in V.&N.T.quatenus
25a) Soli Abrahamo & posteris eius fuit promulgatum & administratum in V.T. in N. autem aliis quoq; populis promulgatur & administratur.
30b) In V.T. fuit obscurius promulgatum & administratum: in nouo promulgatur & administratur clarius.
c) In V. T. minore cum efficacia Spiritus sancti fuit promulgatum & administratum: in nouo promulgatur & administratur maiore cum efficacia.
35d) In V.T.administratio fœderis gratiæ fuit onerosior atq; operosior, quàm est in N.

page.notes: The small numbers at the far left edge (5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 next to the scan's edge) belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. Doubtful readings: "vers.[?]11" for the printed "verl.11"; the printed "A&or" is read as "Actor"; "fcilicet" is read as "scilicet"; "quàm" in the Hebrews line is uncertain. The long s is rendered as a plain s throughout.
